data.one_liner: A lightweight and platform-aware plugin for showing dialogs and alerts.
data.what_it_does: Provides platform-aware dialogs and alerts that adapt their appearance for Android, iOS, and other platforms. Offers extendable basic dialog and action widgets to easily display notices, confirmations, and lists.
use_when: You need platform-aware dialogs that look native on both Android and iOS
You want a lightweight solution for basic alerts and confirmations
avoid_when: You require complex custom transitions or multi-step modal workflows
You are not using Flutter widgets for dialogs
strengths: Easy to use basic alert and action builders
weaknesses: Limited to basic dialog and alert structures
No advanced built-in modal routing or complex dialog states
